NTT DATA strives to hire exceptional, innovative and passionate individuals who want to grow with us. If you want to be part of an inclusive, adaptable, and forward-thinking organization, apply now.
  
  
We are currently seeking a Systems Engineering SPECIALIST - SCCM/Intune to join our team in Noida, Uttar Pradesh (IN-UP), India (IN).

**Job Title:** SCCM/Intune Engineer – Endpoint Management
  
**Location:** India — Pune / Bangalore / Hyderabad / Chennai / Noida (Hybrid)
  
**Employment Type:** Full-Time (Permanent)
  
**Experience:** 4–6 years of experience in enterprise endpoint management with demonstrated proficiency in both Microsoft Intune and ManageEngine, preferably in a managed services or IT outsourcing environment.
  
**Compensation:** Competitive CTC commensurate with experience. Benefits include health insurance (self and family), PF, gratuity, variable performance bonus, leave travel allowance (LTA), and professional certification support.
  
**Work Hours:** IST - aligned shifts; flexibility required for global client coverage
  
  
ROLE OVERVIEW
  
We are seeking a skilled SCCM/Intune Engineer to join NTT DATA's India EPM Delivery Centre. This mid-level role involves independently managing end-to-end endpoint lifecycle operations. We are looking for a dedicated ManageEngine Patch Management Engineer to take full ownership of our endpoint security compliance and automated patching lifecycle. In this role, you will manage, configure, and maintain our deployment of ManageEngine Patch Manager Plus (or Endpoint Central patching modules). Your primary goal will be to secure our enterprise environment by systematically deploying OS updates and keeping third-party applications up to date to minimize our corporate vulnerability footprint.
  
  
KEY RESPONSIBILITIES
  
OS Deployment Image Management
  

* Design, build, and maintain Windows 10/11 OSD task sequences using SCCM/MDT integration for global client environments.
* Manage WinPE boot images, driver packages, and deployment boundaries for OSD operations.
* Support OS refresh, wipe-and-reload, and in-place upgrade deployment scenarios.
* Troubleshoot OSD failures including PXE boot issues, task sequence errors, and driver conflicts.
* Contribute to Windows Autopilot profile configuration and deployment for Intune-managed devices.
* Maintain image documentation including build standards, versioning, and patch currency records.

Patch Management
  

* Automated Patch Deployment (APD): Design, configure, and manage Patch Manager Plus workflows to automate the entire patching lifecycle—from vulnerability database synchronization to final deployment.
* Cross-Platform OS Management: Oversee scheduled and critical patching for a heterogeneous network environment encompassing Windows Endpoints.
* Third-Party Application Patching: Package, test, and push updates for an extensive catalog of supported third-party enterprise software (e.g., Adobe, Java, web browsers, and productivity suites).
* Test Approve Testing Ring Processes: Establish strict deployment policies using non-production test groups to verify patch stability before pushing updates into the production environment.
* Decline Exclude Rule Management: Review security advisories and selectively decline patches that cause known infrastructure conflicts or are incompatible with legacy enterprise software.
* Compliance Reporting: Utilize the Patch Manager dashboard to generate real-time compliance audits, vulnerability summaries, and endpoint patching health reports for executive leadership.

Application Software Management
  

* Manage complex application deployments using SCCM applications with detection methods, requirements, and dependencies.
* Package enterprise applications using .intunewin format and deploy via Intune with advanced targeting.
* Support software metering, asset intelligence, and license management activities in SCCM.
* Design and implement application supersedence and uninstall workflows.
* Collaborate with app packaging teams to validate and test packaged software before production deployment.

Infrastructure Platform Management
  

* Monitor and maintain SCCM site server health, DP replication, and component status for client environments.
* Manage Intune connector, certificate infrastructure, and Intune service health.
* Develop PowerShell scripts for endpoint automation, reporting, and operational efficiency improvements.
* Handle L2/L3 escalations with thorough root cause analysis and permanent fix documentation.
* Participate in change management, CAB reviews, and client operational governance calls during IST business hours.

REQUIRED SKILLS
  

* Microsoft Intune — device management, compliance, WUfB, Win32 app deployment, Autopilot
* ManageEngine — patch management
* Microsoft SCCM/ConfigMgr — OSD, applications, collections, and reporting (proficient)
* Windows 10/11 image management — task sequences, WinPE, driver management, MDT integration
* Azure AD and Hybrid Azure AD join configurations, conditional access, and co-management
* PowerShell scripting for automation, reporting, and endpoint remediation
* SQL/WQL queries for SCCM inventory and compliance reporting
* ITSM operations — incident, problem, and change management (ServiceNow or equivalent)
* Strong written and spoken English for client-facing delivery and documentation

PREFERRED QUALIFICATIONS
  

* Microsoft Certified: Endpoint Administrator (MD-102) or equivalent
* Experience with SCCM-to-Intune co-management and workload migration
* Exposure to Qualys, Tenable, or vulnerability management integration with EPM
* Experience in NTT DATA, Infosys, Wipro, TCS, HCL, or similar IT outsourcing delivery models

MINIMUM EDUCATION
  
Bachelor's degree (B.E./B.Tech/BCA/B.Sc. IT/CS) or MCA from a recognised Indian university. Equivalent experience and industry certifications will be considered.

Overview:

Expleo is a trusted partner for end-to-end, integrated engineering, quality services, and management consulting for digital transformation. We help businesses harness technological change to deliver innovation, improve resilience, and support the secure delivery of complex products, platforms, and systems.

As part of the Expleo UK Cybersecurity Practice, you will join a managed Cyber Operations service for a major UK energy network operator that forms part of the UK's Critical National Infrastructure (CNI). The service is governed by Expleo in the UK, with a 24/7 UK Security Operations Centre delivered by a specialist partner and an Expleo consultancy team in India providing design, engineering and assurance expertise across the client's security tooling estate.

As **Senior Security Architect**, you will be the senior technical adviser within the offshore consultancy team. Working under the technical direction of the UK Head of Service, who holds design authority, you will produce the security architecture, design and risk material that underpins the service, and provide technical leadership to the offshore engineers.

**This is a design, review and advisory role.** You will work within Expleo's offshore consultancy team, outside the client's operational environment. You will not have access to the client's operational systems or data and will not make live changes. Operational changes are implemented by UK-based, security-cleared personnel; your work provides the designs, analysis, recommendations and assurance that those changes depend on. You will work from information released to the team through Expleo's controlled UK service boundary.

Responsibilities:

**Responsibilities**

* Produce and maintain security architecture and design documentation (high-level and low-level designs) for the client's security tooling estate, for approval by the UK Head of Service.

* Assess and recommend tooling and approaches for PKI and secrets management.

If you are an experienced Security Architect with a strong background in enterprise and CNI security architecture, and you enjoy shaping how critical services are secured, we encourage you to apply today.

3. Power Systems Architecture, PowerVM & VIOS Engineering

. Design and implement PowerVM virtualization solutions, including Virtual I/O Server (VIOS) clustering, Shared Ethernet Adapter (SEA) failover, and N\_Port ID Virtualization (NPIV) SAN mapping.  
. Engineer enterprise LPAR topology, configuring shared processor pools, capped/uncapped partitions, Virtual Processors, and dynamic processor/memory optimization.  
. Lead HMC firmware lifecycles, service processor firmware upgrades, and disaster recovery replication for HMC configurations.  
  
4. Enterprise HA/DR Architecture & Disaster Recovery Orchestration  
  
. Design, implement, and fine tune enterprise High Availability (HA) replication architectures using solutions such as Precisely MIMIX, IBM PowerHA SystemMirror, or Maxava HA.  
. Architect journal environments: Remote Journaling (RJ), asynchronous/synchronous network transport, dual journal receivers, and threshold management.  
. Architect and lead scheduled enterprise Disaster Recovery (DR) and full role swap (switchover / failover) tests, guaranteeing stringent Recovery Time Objectives (RTO) and Recovery Point Objectives (RPO).  
. Develop and maintain automated failover scripts, audit validation procedures, and emergency split brain recovery playbooks.  
  
5. Storage Engineering, IASP & Resiliency Architecture  
  
. Architect auxiliary storage topologies, balancing internal NVMe/SAS drives and external SAN arrays (IBM FlashSystem, DS8000) using San Volume Controller (SVC).  
. Implement and manage Independent Auxiliary Storage Pools (IASP) to isolate databases for modular switchover and flash copy operations.  
. Formulate enterprise wide BRMS (Backup, Recovery, and Media Services) architecture, including network synced BRMS clusters, media lifecycle policies, and VTL encryption.  
. Author and validate bare metal disaster recovery procedures, cold start installation plans, and full scale recovery runs (SAVSYS / Option 21 rebuilds).  
  
6. Advanced Performance Tuning, Profiling & Capacity Planning  
  
. Conduct deep tier system performance profiling utilizing IBM i Performance Data Investigator (PDI), Collection Services, Job Watcher, Disk Watcher, and IBM i Doctor.  
. Optimize system memory allocation by tuning dynamic system values (QPFRADJ), defining private memory pools, and resolving object lock contention.  
. Analyze disk subsystem bottlenecks, arm contention, queue depths, and optimize paging space allocation.  
. Formulate multi year capacity planning models predicting CPU (CPW), memory, and SAN storage expansion aligned with corporate business growth.  
  
7. Security Hardening, Audit Forensics & Compliance Architecture  
  
. Architect and enforce OS security hardening in accordance with IBM i Security Level 40 and 50 standards.  
. Establish comprehensive security auditing architectures via QAUDJRN, configuring journal filters for security critical actions and unauthorized object manipulation.  
. Implement adopted authority controls, secure system values (QSECURITY, QPWD\*, QALWUSRDMN), and service program access controls.  
. Drive compliance and vulnerability management programs (SOX, PCI DSS, ISO 27001), designing automated scripts to remediate non compliant configurations.  
  
8. Infrastructure Automation, Modernization & Technical Mentorship  
  
. Architect reusable operational automation utilizing advanced Control Language (CL) programs and modern Db2 for i / IBM i Services (QSYS2).  
. Evaluate and implement modern administration frameworks, such as IBM i open source integration (PASE, Bash, Python), Ansible for IBM i automation, and REST APIs.

We help businesses harness technological change to deliver innovation, improve resilience, and support the secure delivery of complex products, platforms, and systems.

As part of the Expleo UK Cybersecurity Practice, you will join a managed Cyber Operations service for a major UK energy network operator that forms part of the UK's Critical National Infrastructure (CNI). The service is governed by Expleo in the UK, with a 24/7 UK Security Operations Centre delivered by a specialist partner and an Expleo consultancy team in India providing design, engineering and assurance expertise across the client's security tooling estate.

As **Vulnerability and Patch Manager**, you will lead the vulnerability intelligence, prioritisation and patch advisory service across the client's server, end-user, network and security device estate, coordinating remediation through the client's operational teams and suppliers.

**This is a design, review and advisory role.** You will work within Expleo's offshore consultancy team, outside the client's operational environment. You will not have access to the client's operational systems or data and will not make live changes. Operational changes are implemented by UK-based, security-cleared personnel; your work provides the designs, analysis, recommendations and assurance that those changes depend on. You will work from information released to the team through Expleo's controlled UK service boundary.

Responsibilities:

**Responsibilities**

* Lead a continuous vulnerability assessment programme, using outputs from the client's vulnerability management platform released through the UK service boundary.
* Prioritise vulnerabilities using threat-informed criteria (CVSS, EPSS, CISA KEV, NCSC advisories and vendor PSIRTs) and produce monthly remediation recommendations.
* Issue critical patch advisories, typically within 24 hours, based on client guidance and credible threat intelligence, to enable expedited remediation by UK-based personnel and client suppliers.
* Produce a monthly report on vendor patch and firmware releases across the server, end-user, mobile, network and security estate.
* Produce OS patch and device firmware compliance reports.
* Consolidate patch and upgrade status reporting for firewalls, intrusion prevention, email gateway, secure web gateway and application control platforms.
* Track intrusion prevention signature (digital vaccine) compliance against the 48-hour target, working with the Security Engineer | Network.
* Maintain the vulnerability exception and risk acceptance register and present items for decision through service governance.
* Prepare and co-facilitate the monthly vulnerability and patch review with the UK Head of Service, client teams and third-party suppliers.
* Carry out targeted vulnerability analysis in support of incidents and investigations when directed.
* Apply safe practice for operational technology (OT) assets, where scanning and patching are constrained.
* Support the growth of Expleo's Cybersecurity Practice through knowledge sharing and technical contribution.

Qualifications:

* Degree in computer science, cybersecurity or a related discipline, or equivalent professional experience.
* Vulnerability management vendor certification, e.g. Rapid7, Tenable or Qualys (at least one required).
* CompTIA CySA+, PenTest+, GIAC GEVA, or ITIL 4 Foundation would be advantageous.

Essential skills:

* Vulnerability management platforms (e.g. Rapid7 InsightVM, Tenable, Qualys) and interpretation of their outputs.
* Patch management processes and tooling (e.g. Intune/MECM, Ivanti, Tanium, BigFix).
* Threat-informed prioritisation using CVSS, EPSS, CISA KEV and vendor advisories.
* Coordinating remediation across internal teams and third-party suppliers.
* Strong reporting and data analysis (Excel, Power BI).
* Clear, concise written advisories for technical and non-technical audiences.

Desired skills:

* OT vulnerability management and safe scanning practice.
* Energy, utilities or other CNI sector experience.
* Experience supporting NIS or CAF-aligned assurance reporting.

Experience:

* 8-12 years in IT security or infrastructure, including 4+ years managing vulnerability and patch management programmes.
* Experience running risk exception and acceptance processes through governance.

* Be based in, or willing to relocate to, Chennai.

Benefits:

An engineer who started in site execution and has moved onto a project management track, with strong quantity surveying ability.

**Budgeting & Estimation**

* Prepare project budgets for new centres, client interior modifications and repair or upgrade works.

* Rate analysis and benchmarking against prevailing Chennai and Bangalore market rates; build and maintain an internal rate library.
* Develop cost per seat and cost per sq.ft. benchmarks by centre and by scope, and provide fit-out cost inputs for client proposals and landlord negotiations.

**Planning & Scheduling**

* Prepare project schedules identifying the critical path and the activities that must run in sequence versus in parallel.
* Prepare procurement and material delivery schedules aligned to the construction programme.
* Track actual progress against baseline, flag slippage early and prepare recovery plans.
* Maintain look-ahead plans and daily and weekly progress reporting.

**Tendering & Procurement**

* Prepare tender documents, float RFQs and RFIs, and run pre-bid clarifications.
* Prepare technical and commercial comparative statements and recommend award.
* Draft work orders with unambiguous scope, rates, measurement basis, payment terms and timelines.
* Identify and develop new vendors and contractors across civil, MEP and specialist trades.

**Measurement, Billing & Certification**

* Carry out joint measurement at site and record measurements in the measurement book.
* Verify contractor RA bills against the BOQ, work order rates and actual site measurement, and certify for payment.
* Maintain deviation and variation statements with rate justification for non-BOQ and extra items.
* Reconcile free-issue and client-supplied material.
* Track advances, retention, recoveries, debit notes, and final bill settlement and closure.
* Coordinate with finance for release of payments against certification.

* Prepare and close snag lists; complete handover documentation including as-builts, warranties, O&M manuals and asset registers.

* Track estimated versus actual cost line by line; maintain a variation register and flag overruns before they are incurred.
* Identify value-engineering opportunities and quantify the saving and the trade-off.
* Prepare monthly MIS on cost, schedule and quality across all live projects.
* Prepare decision notes and options analyses for management on technical and commercial matters.

The Industrial Automation and PLC Programming Lead will serve as a technical subject\-matter expert for shop\-floor automation and controls systems supporting manufacturing operations and forward model programs.
This position combines hands\-on production support with long\-term technical standardization. The role will manage and prioritize automation\-related support requests, troubleshoot production\-impacting issues, perform root\-cause analysis, and serve as an escalation point for complex or recurring controls problems.
The position will also lead the development, documentation, and implementation of programming standards, reusable software libraries, naming conventions, controls templates, and engineering best practices. The role will work closely with manufacturing engineering, information technology, operational technology, equipment suppliers, system integrators, and plant support teams to ensure that automation solutions are reliable, secure, maintainable, and aligned with applicable organizational and Original Equipment Manufacturer standards.
**Production and Technical Support**
* Manage and prioritize technical support requests involving PLCs, HMIs, MES interfaces, robotics, and industrial connectivity systems.
* Provide advanced troubleshooting and programming support for production\-impacting controls and automation issues.
* Diagnose PLC logic, HMI application, communication, robotics, and shop\-floor system failures.
* Perform structured root\-cause analysis and implement sustainable corrective and preventive actions.
* Act as an escalation point for complex, recurring, or high\-impact technical issues.
* Coordinate with manufacturing, maintenance, controls engineering, information technology, operational technology, and supplier teams during issue resolution.
* Maintain accurate records of incidents, technical findings, implemented solutions, and lessons learned.
* Define and monitor appropriate service\-level measures and key performance indicators for issue response, resolution, system reliability, and recurring failures.

**Controls Standards and Standardization**
* Develop, document, implement, and maintain PLC and HMI programming standards.
* Establish consistent naming conventions, program structures, alarm strategies, diagnostic methods, and documentation requirements.
* Develop reusable logic modules, Add\-On Instructions, function blocks, HMI objects, templates, and software libraries.
* Lead the migration or alignment of legacy controls programs with approved standards and reusable architectures.
* Conduct technical design reviews and periodic audits to assess compliance with established controls standards.
* Identify opportunities to reduce engineering effort, improve maintainability, and increase consistency across equipment and manufacturing lines.
* Establish appropriate software backup, change\-management, release\-management, and version\-control practices for PLC, HMI, and robot programs.
* Maintain standard technical documents, implementation guidelines, checklists, and validation procedures.
* Support the structured rollout and adoption of new controls standards across relevant plants, programs, or production lines.

**PLC and HMI Engineering**
* Develop, modify, debug, validate, and support PLC applications using platforms such as Allen\-Bradley Studio 5000, Siemens TIA Portal, or equivalent industrial controls platforms.
* Develop and maintain HMI applications using platforms such as FactoryTalk View, Siemens WinCC, or equivalent technologies.
* Review and optimize PLC program architecture, sequencing, interlocks, alarms, fault handling, and equipment diagnostics.
* Support commissioning, production launch, equipment integration, and continuous\-improvement activities.
* Ensure that controls programs are appropriately documented, tested, backed up, and maintained.
* Support the implementation of effective equipment recovery, troubleshooting, and diagnostic features.

**Manufacturing Execution System Integration**
* Support and troubleshoot interfaces between manufacturing equipment, PLCs, supervisory systems, and Manufacturing Execution Systems.
* Investigate data\-quality, equipment\-status, production\-tracking, and system\-integration issues.
* Support industrial data exchange using technologies such as Open Platform Communications Unified Architecture, commonly known as OPC UA.
* Collaborate with MES and information technology teams to maintain reliable communication between shop\-floor controls and manufacturing applications.
* Help ensure the accuracy, availability, and integrity of manufacturing data.

**Industrial Connectivity and IIoT**
* Support the implementation and troubleshooting of Message Queuing Telemetry Transport, or MQTT, and other industrial data communication solutions.
* Support Industrial Internet of Things gateways, edge devices, sensors, communication brokers, and associated data pipelines.
* Develop or maintain standard configurations for industrial connectivity solutions.
* Support technologies such as Sparkplug B, Ignition, Kepware, or equivalent industrial integration platforms where applicable.
* Work with information technology and operational technology teams to ensure industrial connectivity solutions meet applicable networking, cybersecurity, reliability, and data\-governance requirements.
* Support the availability of manufacturing data for approved monitoring, reporting, and analytical applications.

**Robotics Support**
* Support troubleshooting, program review, and optimization for industrial robotic systems.
* Work with robot platforms such as FANUC, ABB, or equivalent industrial robotics technologies.
* Coordinate with controls engineers, equipment suppliers, integrators, and production teams to resolve robot\-related manufacturing issues.
* Support robot program backup, change control, documentation, and recovery procedures.
* Identify opportunities to improve robot reliability, cycle performance, diagnostics, and maintainability.

**Forward Model Program Support**
* Support automation planning, technical reviews, equipment integration, commissioning, and production launch activities for forward model programs.
* Review supplier and system\-integrator controls designs for compliance with approved technical standards.
* Participate in design reviews, software reviews, equipment acceptance activities, and launch\-readiness assessments.
* Identify automation risks and recommend appropriate technical countermeasures.
* Capture lessons learned from launches and production support activities and incorporate them into future standards and program requirements.

**Technical Leadership and Documentation**
* Serve as a technical subject\-matter expert for controls and industrial automation.
* Provide technical guidance and mentoring to engineers, technicians, manufacturing teams, and support personnel.
* Create standard operating procedures, technical specifications, troubleshooting guides, training materials, and engineering standards.
* Facilitate technical reviews, problem\-solving sessions, and knowledge\-sharing activities.
* Communicate technical risks, recommendations, issue status, and implementation plans clearly to technical and non\-technical stakeholders.
* Promote continuous improvement, technical discipline, knowledge sharing, and the consistent application of engineering standards.

**Education**
* Bachelor’s degree in Electrical Engineering, Electronics Engineering, Instrumentation Engineering, Mechatronics Engineering, Control Systems Engineering, Automation Engineering, or a closely related discipline.
* An equivalent combination of relevant education and significant industrial automation experience may be considered, subject to organizational policy.

**Required Experience**
* Approximately 6 to 10 years of relevant experience in industrial automation, controls engineering, PLC programming, or manufacturing systems.
* Strong hands\-on experience developing, troubleshooting, and maintaining PLC applications.
* Experience developing or supporting industrial HMI applications.
* Experience troubleshooting production equipment and resolving manufacturing automation issues.
* Experience performing root\-cause analysis and implementing permanent corrective actions.
* Experience documenting controls standards, technical procedures, or engineering best practices.
* Experience collaborating with manufacturing, maintenance, engineering, information technology, suppliers, or system integrators.

**Required Technical Knowledge**
* Strong knowledge of PLC programming principles, industrial controls architecture, sequencing, interlocks, alarms, and equipment diagnostics.
* Experience with at least one major PLC platform, such as:
* Allen\-Bradley ControlLogix or CompactLogix using Studio 5000
* Siemens SIMATIC using TIA Portal
* An equivalent industrial PLC platform
* Experience with HMI development using FactoryTalk View, Siemens WinCC, or an equivalent platform.
* Working knowledge of industrial communication systems and protocols.
* Understanding of industrial Ethernet and shop\-floor network fundamentals.
* Ability to read and interpret controls documentation, electrical drawings, network architecture diagrams, and equipment specifications.
* Strong technical documentation and structured problem\-solving skills.

This role requires a work schedule providing approximately 4–5 hours of daily overlap with US Central Time, as well as availability outside normal hours for scheduled monthly maintenance windows and semi\-annual disaster recovery (DR) tests.
